description: The home-services catalog ONZIP keeps for each country where it has launched (moving, cleaning, repair, lawn care, babysitters, tutors and more): service id, group, whether providers answer with a quote or by applying, and whether it can repeat. Countries ONZIP has not launched in are not listed. Requesting a job in the app is not open yet — the first ONZIP release covers home records (repairs, warranties, attached buildings, equipment, an inventory of owned items) and move-in and move-out condition reports. There are no provider listings or prices on this server.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. CA. Omit for every launched country.
